caelen.speaker: CAELEN
caelen.text: Dawnfaith land. Their seal was in the Cinder King's ledger. I want to know what they bought.

seraphine.speaker: SERAPHINE
seraphine.text: Home. I'm coming back with a Foundry machine at my side. No one will sing for that.

nimue.speaker: NIMUE
nimue.text: Sanctuary land. They sold their bread to the Cinder King. Let's see who else they deal with.

neutral.speaker: ORION
neutral.text: Dawnfaith land. The road is watched.

orion.speaker: ORION
orion.text: These ones believe. Hurting them will not make them stop. It makes them faster.

caelen.speaker: CAELEN
caelen.text: Bells, and no one ringing them.

seraphine.speaker: SERAPHINE
seraphine.text: The hour bells. Once, everyone below knew the time by them.

nimue.speaker: NIMUE
nimue.text: Runners set their routes by these bells. They've been quiet a long time.

neutral.speaker: ORION
neutral.text: The bells where the hours were rung.

open.speaker: ORION
open.text: Each bell carries its hour. Ring them in order, first to last. One out of turn, and they all fall silent.

open.speaker: ORION
open.text: These fall silent on their own. Clear the way first, then ring all three before the first goes quiet.

caelen.speaker: CAELEN
caelen.text: Every wall is lit, and it's still dimmer here than it should be.

seraphine.speaker: SERAPHINE
seraphine.text: The cloister where I learned to read the light. The lamps were brighter then.

nimue.speaker: NIMUE
nimue.text: Runners slept here when the roads were bad. The doors were open then.

neutral.speaker: ORION
neutral.text: A cloister. Every wall is lit.

line.speaker: ORION
line.text: Above us. When the light gathers on it, turn your back. Whoever looks at it will not see for a moment.

caelen.speaker: CAELEN
caelen.text: Two of them, and one oath.

seraphine.speaker: SERAPHINE
seraphine.text: They mean every word of it. That's what frightens me.

nimue.speaker: NIMUE
nimue.text: Bribe one, and the other still says no. That's why runners went round.

trusted.speaker: ORION
trusted.text: If one falls alone, the other raises it. Wear them down evenly, and bring them down together.

watched.speaker: ORION
watched.text: If one falls alone, the other raises it. They must fall within moments of each other.

neutral.speaker: ORION
neutral.text: If one falls alone, the other raises it.

vow.speaker: SWORN SHIELD
vow.text: Not while one of us stands.

orion.speaker: ORION
orion.text: Too far apart. Strike the one with more left, and finish them together.

caelen.speaker: CAELEN
caelen.text: A long way up. Whoever built this wanted you tired when you got there.

seraphine.speaker: SERAPHINE
seraphine.text: The Choir Stair. They used to sing the hours from these steps. No one is singing.

nimue.speaker: NIMUE
nimue.text: Long stair, no exits. Runners hate a place like this.

neutral.speaker: ORION
neutral.text: The Choir Stair. A long way up.

trusted.speaker: ORION
trusted.text: Someone at the top has been listening to us all the way up. I am beside you.

other.speaker: ORION
other.text: Someone at the top has been listening to us all the way up. I will go first.

caelen.speaker: CAELEN
caelen.text: You were listening all the way up. Then you know why I came.

seraphine.speaker: SERAPHINE
seraphine.text: The ledgers had our seal on them. I want to know what was bought with it.

nimue.speaker: NIMUE
nimue.text: You've been listening. Then you know what I'm here for.

oracle.speaker: LAST ORACLE
oracle.text: I have seen how this ends. The light goes out, and everyone is finally still.

oracle2.speaker: LAST ORACLE
oracle2.text: I will not stop it. I will only make it gentle.

caelen.speaker: CAELEN
caelen.text: She was certain. That's what frightened me.

seraphine.speaker: SERAPHINE
seraphine.text: She spoke for the light as if it had already finished speaking.

nimue.speaker: NIMUE
nimue.text: No ledger up here. Nothing to buy. Just someone who wanted it all over.

orion.speaker: ORION
orion.text: She was sure. Being sure is not the same as being right.

orion2.speaker: ORION
orion2.text: You watch me for lies. Watch the certain ones too.
